items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf) for Sunday; McVay says minor but lacked power/explosion, will test pregame. Game-time decision critical for Rams WR hierarchy.
items.why: Calf issue noted Thursday practice; DNP Friday; Rapoport minor but up-in-air; McVay pregame test.
items.implication: If OUT, targets funnel to Higbee/Parkinson/Atwell etc.; monitor closely for slate.
items.opportunity: TE/WR depth chart elevation if inactive

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (ankle) for Sunday vs Bengals; status crucial for DFS main slate.
items.why: Official listing; returned to practice earlier with limp notes.
items.implication: If OUT, Huntley starts; Ravens offense downgrade, Flowers/Henry impacted.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad); status key for Sunday slate.
items.why: ETR dump; Levitan flags as crucial DFS.
items.implication: If active vs MIA, start; if OUT, Jets RB committee/backup elevates.

items.text: Ruled OUT Sunday: Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Brian Robinson, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, David Montgomery, Jeremiyah Love, Rashee Rice, Zach Charbonnet, Davante Adams (among others).

items.text: 49ers ruled out Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel for Sunday vs Falcons; Shanahan confirmed Evans (Achilles) OUT.
items.why: Official out; coach confirm via Rapoport for Evans.
items.implication: Massive WR vacuum; Kittle/CMC/remaining pass-catchers funnel.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN; was allowed facility meetings/lifting/medical (non-football). Backups Lloyd/Johnson poor EPA.
items.why: ETR IN list; Levitan facility notes + backup inefficiency.
items.implication: Clear start; GB RB hierarchy locked.

items.text: Saquon Barkley looks set to return Week 7; if active vs Cowboys, right back into fantasy lineups (agreed with Stephania Bell).
items.implication: Must-start RB if active on MNF; Eagles backfield clears.

items.text: If Breece Hall plays vs Miami, going right back into starting lineup despite Stephania Bell caution on immediate return.
items.why: Matchup vs MIA; talent overrides rust concerns if active.
items.implication: Strong start signal if cleared from Q.
items.opportunity: Featured RB role expected if active

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen.
items.why: McVay notes on calf limiting explosion; Adams already OUT long-term.
items.implication: Higbee primary beneficiary as TE1 funnel in depleted WR room.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to TE1 and remaining WRs

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK (thank Caleb): since Williams return, 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec and 60+ yards both games.
items.why: Usage spike with Caleb; Kmet now IR season-ending further boosts.
items.opportunity: Target share, routes, red-zone with Kmet out

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most); recent RB receptions high. Sweet full-opp setup for Bijan Robinson vs SF.
items.why: BRob listed OUT; SF allowing RB catches recently (White/Holani/Harvey/Love data); DvP stats.
items.implication: Bijan full workload + pass-game upside in favorable matchup.
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, snaps vs weak RB DvP

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts Sunday: awesome player/scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). Not 'National TE Day'.
items.why: WR injuries create target vacuum; scheme funnels to Kittle.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR (season-ending knee) may reduce 2-/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Route % + YPRR data; Kmet serious knee to IR per Rapoport/Schefter/Johnson.
items.implication: Increased route share/opportunity in Bears offense ROS.

items.text: Tempted to buy CMC lining up more in slot this week given 49ers dire WR situation (Evans/Deebo OUT) and Kaelon Black presence; rarely true but smile quote + context.
items.why: CMC quote on possible slot with WR injuries; Vic Tafur report.
items.implication: Potential receiving upside boost beyond normal RB role.
items.conflict: Historical RB-as-WR statements rarely materialize fully
